messages:
Alex (Platform): heads-up: thinking about adding an 'effective token cost' line to the cost dashboard — combines token burn, cache savings, and routing mix per-model. sketch below.
Priya (Product): :eyes: can that help teams see when a cheaper fallback is actually more cost-effective despite worse latency?
Alex (Platform): yes — goal is per-model/unit econ so product teams can see tradeoffs. also helps quota UX: show projected burn if route changes.
Morgan (DataEng): we need telemetry to capture per-request routing_reason + cache_hit bool + model_variant. current logs only have model_id + latency.
Samir (SRE): big ask — adding those tags increases cardinality. we should sample or derive via join. also fallback spikes yesterday because routing didn't consider batch sizes.
Jamie (DX): on the console side, UX should avoid noise. suggest aggregated 'effective cost per 1k tokens' and a toggle to break down by route/model. show delta vs baseline by default.
Alex (Platform): proto calc: `effective_cost = (gross_token_cost - cache_credit) / effective_tokens` where `cache_credit = cache_hits * avg_saved_tokens * token_price_of_skipped_model`. quick SQL-ish example:
```
SELECT model_id,
       SUM(gross_cost) AS gross_cost,
       SUM(cache_saved_cost) AS cache_credit,
       SUM(tokens_generated) AS tokens,
       (SUM(gross_cost) - SUM(cache_saved_cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(tokens),0) AS effective_cost_per_token
FROM inference_events_v2
GROUP BY model_id;
```
Morgan (DataEng): we also need to attribute cache savings when prefix cache is shared across tenants — hard allocation. propose: credit savings to the route that initiated prefetch within X minutes, and surface sampling uncertainty.
Priya (Product): for quotas: show projected quota burn if route switches to fallback variant. maybe a 'what-if' slider in the panel.
Samir (SRE): operational note: when routing to Dedicated vs Hosted, respect reserved capacity. cost calc must separate reserved (committed) vs metered tokens to avoid confusing finance.
Alex (Platform): :thumbsup: good call — we'll split by `deployment_type` label and expose reserved vs metered in the breakdown.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: telemetry schema v2 proposed. CI checklist requires migration plan. PR #4523 opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/4523
Jamie (DX): next steps: Alex + Morgan + Jamie to design an API for the dashboard; Priya to mock product panel; Samir to advise on sampling / reserved split. target: preview by next Tuesday.
Alex (Platform): i'll spin up a PoC using sampled logs and post screenshots in this thread.
Priya (Product): :rocket: sounds good — please add the preview to the roadmap and link rollout notes when ready.
Samir (SRE): one more: add an alert if effective_cost jumps > 30% in 1h for a model (helps catch routing regressions).
Jamie (DX): noted for UX: we'll show a small alert banner and a quick 'explain' flyout with recent routing mix and cache hit trends.
Alex (Platform): thanks all — i'll send an initial spec + data sample by EOD tomorrow.
